gloss: to say everything; to express fully; to exhaust words

definitions.gloss: to say everything; to express fully; to exhaust words
definitions.explanation: To express something completely, leaving nothing unsaid. Most often used in the negative potential form, describing feelings too great to put fully into words.

examples.japanese: {感謝|かんしゃ}の{気持|きも}ちは{言|い}い{尽|つ}くせない。
examples.english: I cannot fully express my gratitude.

examples.japanese: {短|みじか}い{手紙|てがみ}では{思|おも}いを{言|い}い{尽|つ}くせなかった。
examples.english: I couldn't say all I felt in a short letter.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{素晴|すば}らしさは、どんな{言葉|ことば}を{使|つか}っても{言|い}い{尽|つ}くせない。
examples.english: No matter what words I use, I can't fully express how wonderful she is.

notes:
Compound of {言|い}う (to say) + {尽|つ}くす (to exhaust, to use up completely). Most often appears in the negative potential form {言|い}い{尽|つ}くせない, describing feelings too deep to put fully into words.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {言|い}い{尽|つ}くせない{思|おも}い: feelings beyond words
- {感謝|かんしゃ}を{言|い}い{尽|つ}くす: to express one's full gratitude
- {魅力|みりょく}を{言|い}い{尽|つ}くす: to describe every charm

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {語|かた}り{尽|つ}くす: to tell everything — focuses on narrating or discussing at length
- {表現|ひょうげん}する: to express — neutral and general, without the nuance of completeness
